adjudication.rationale:
In the migration `CreateEmbeddableHosts`, the old setting value is split with `val.split("
")` and each entry is inserted via raw SQL without stripping/rejecting blanks: `records.each do |h| execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)" end`. If the legacy `embeddable_hosts` setting contains blank lines (e.g., consecutive `
` or trailing newline), `split("
")` will include `""` entries, which will be inserted as empty-string `host` rows (allowed by `null: false`). These would then appear in `Admin::EmbeddingController#fetch_embedding` via `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)` and render as junk/blank rows in the admin table.
